name: Settings Showcase
author: PixelParts Demo
description: Full demonstration of all supported setting types, icons, shapes, activities and visual elements

settings.title: Master Enable
settings.description: Global toggle for the demo addon

settings.title: Demo Warning
settings.description: This is a demonstration addon. It does not hook any packages — it only showcases the settings UI generator capabilities. All values are written to Settings.Global but have no runtime effect.

settings.title: Basic Input Controls
settings.description: Standard controls for boolean, integer, float and string values.

settings.title: Toggle (switch)
settings.description: Standard on/off switch

settings.title: Toggle (checkbox)
settings.description: Checkbox variant

settings.title: Integer Slider
settings.description: Discrete integer value with step

settings.title: Float Slider
settings.description: Continuous float value

settings.title: Text Input
settings.description: Free-form string value

settings.title: Dropdown Select
settings.description: Classic dropdown menu

settings.title: Button Select
settings.description: Radio-button style selection with animated highlight

settings.title: Color Picker (HEX)
settings.description: Standard hex color without alpha

settings.title: Color Picker (RGBA + Alpha)
settings.description: RGBA format with alpha slider

main.title: Visual Elements
main.subtitle: Warnings, dividers, spacers, images, text blocks

settings.title: Default Warning
settings.description: This uses the default error container color from the system theme. Tap to expand and see the full message.

settings.title: Custom Color Warning
settings.description: This warning uses a custom orange color to indicate a non-critical but important notice.

settings.title: Info Notice
settings.description: Blue-tinted informational notice. Use this for tips and non-dangerous information.

settings.title: Section Header
settings.description: This is a text/info block. Use it to add explanatory text between settings.

settings.title: Expandable Group
settings.description: Tap to expand and see nested settings

settings.title: Exclusive Toggles
settings.description: Only one of these can be active at a time (exclusiveGroup).

settings.title: File Icon (from JAR)
settings.description: Loaded from META-INF/icons/custom_icon.png

main.title: Advanced Features
main.subtitle: File storage, app picker, complex scenarios

settings.title: Advanced Section
settings.description: These features demonstrate file-based storage, app pickers, and complex multi-value scenarios.

settings.title: Config File
settings.description: Select a JSON configuration file

settings.title: Target Apps
settings.description: Select which apps this feature applies to

settings.title: Multi-value Configuration
settings.description: Complex nested settings with mixed types

settings.title: Settings.Global
settings.description: Stored in Settings.Global (default)

settings.title: Settings.System
settings.description: Stored in Settings.System

settings.title: File Storage
settings.description: Stored in addon data directory

settings.title: Dynamic Tiles
settings.description: Bind quick settings tiles to addon keys. Tiles can toggle a boolean key or cycle through a carousel of values. Long-press opens the addon settings page.

settings.title: Demo Toggle Tile
settings.description: Off

settings.title: Demo Carousel Tile
settings.description: Disabled

settings.title: Display Settings
settings.description: These settings appear inline without a separate container

settings.title: Custom Background Group
settings.description: This expandable group has a custom background color

main.title: File-based Options
main.subtitle: Select options loaded from external JSON

settings.title: External Options Source
settings.description: These selectors load their options from a JSON file in the addon data directory. A hook can generate this file at runtime, and the UI will read it dynamically.

settings.title: Dynamic Profile
settings.description: Options loaded from profiles.json

settings.title: Dynamic Mode
settings.description: Button-style selector from modes.json

main.title: Custom Category
main.subtitle: This uses a custom group name

settings.title: Custom Group
settings.description: This entry uses group='Tweaks' which creates a new section in the activity with that name. Custom groups are sorted by their highest priority entry.

settings.title: Apps (chips visible)
settings.description: Selected apps shown as chips below

settings.title: Apps (chips hidden)
settings.description: Selected apps NOT shown below the button
